rows.note: Use this for something extending throughout Hong Kong; it is the common local-territory version.

example.english: This is a countrywide survey, and every district is included.
example.traditional: 呢個調查係全港性嘅，所有區都有份。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 diu6 caa4 hai6 cyun4 gong2 sing3 ge3 so2 jau5 keoi1 dou1 jau5 fan6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something extending throughout an entire country.

example.english: This is a countrywide reform that will be rolled out across all the provinces at the same time.
example.traditional: 呢項改革係全國性嘅，會喺各省同步推行。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 goi2 gaak3 hai6 cyun4 gwok3 sing3 ge3 wui5 hai2 gok3 saang2 tung4 bou6 teoi1 hang4
